barriers.description: Usability testing is conducted by the external vendor (Pivot Design Group) and data are shared with the research team only in aggregate, limiting researchers' direct access to raw user data. This restricts designers' ability to inspect detailed think-aloud outputs and participant-level findings.
barriers.justification: Aggregated reporting and external conduction of usability sessions hinder designers' ability to manage user understanding, evaluate designs deeply, and integrate granular feedback for iteration because they cannot access or analyze individual-level interaction data.
barriers.reference_excerpt: We will recruit usability participants from our network via email, and their participation will be consented by Pivot Design Group, who will conduct the testing. Data will be collected for development purposes only and shared with the research team in aggregate.

barriers.description: The study intentionally provides minimal direction about the nature of target EBIs because it is unknown for which types of innovations the tool will be useful, creating uncertainty about target use cases. This vagueness limits the specificity of user requirements and contextual constraints for design.
barriers.justification: Lack of clarity about the kinds of EBIs to support hinders designers' ability to understand context of use and to specify concrete user requirements, which in turn constrains the production of tailored design solutions and focused evaluation criteria.
barriers.reference_excerpt: We will intentionally provide minimal direction regarding the nature of the target EBIs since it is not yet known for what types of innovations it will be useful.
